name: Saripidem
summary: Saripidem is a sedative and anxiolytic drug in the imidazopyridine family, which is related to the better known drugs zolpidem and alpidem. Saripidem has a similar pharmacological profile to the benzodiazepine family of drugs including sedative and anxiolytic properties, but its chemical structure is quite different from that of the benzodiazepine drugs, and saripidem is described as a nonbenzodiazepine.

pharmacology.text: The mechanism of action by which saripidem produces its sedative and anxiolytic effects is by modulating the benzodiazepine binding site on GABAA receptors, however unlike many older GABAA agonists, saripidem is highly subtype selective and binds primarily to the ω1 subtype.

summaryZh: 沙立吡旦（英語：Saripidem）是咪唑並吡啶家族中的鎮靜劑和抗焦慮藥，與更廣為人知的藥物唑吡坦和阿吡坦有關。
summaryZhHans: 沙立吡旦（英语：Saripidem）是咪唑并吡啶家族中的镇静剂和抗焦虑药，与更广为人知的药物唑吡坦和阿吡坦有关。

uses.en: It was studied as a sedative and anti-anxiety drug but was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究作為鎮靜和抗焦慮藥物，但從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究作为镇静和抗焦虑药物，但从未上市。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs acting at benzodiazepine sites can cause drowsiness, poor coordination and memory problems, and regular use can lead to dependence.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。作用於苯二氮平位點的藥物可能引起嗜睡、協調變差和記憶問題，規律使用可能導致依賴。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。作用于苯二氮平位点的药物可能引起嗜睡、协调制差和记忆问题，规律使用可能导致依赖。

fact.en: Saripidem is an imidazopyridine, the same family as the sleep medicine zolpidem and the anti-anxiety drug alpidem, which was withdrawn over liver damage.
fact.zh: 沙立吡旦屬於咪唑吡啶類，和安眠藥佐沛眠及抗焦慮藥 alpidem 同一家族，後者因肝損傷而下市。
fact.zhHans: 沙立吡旦属于咪唑吡啶类，和安眠药佐沛眠及抗焦虑药 alpidem 同一家族，后者因肝损伤而下市。
